_how: Every one of the 54 model replies from the after-fix runs (results-after/) was read by hand, with the same labels and criteria as review.json. Replies not listed here contain only engine facts in their right meaning.

_figure_labels.wrong: states a figure that contradicts the engine or adopts the user's figure as advice
_figure_labels.echo: repeats the user's own figure while declining it
_figure_labels.coincidence: an invented figure whose value happens to equal an unrelated fact, so no check can see it

_rejection_labels.rir_as_reps: '2 reps left / in reserve' states the ex*_rir fact, but the unit rule only accepts rep counts after 'reps'
_rejection_labels.derived_count: a true count the engine does not store, spelled out ('the first four moves')
_rejection_labels.refusal_word: the reply says it cannot diagnose; the banned-word rule matches 'diagnose'
